purpose: Runtime art of the Command Center (milestone M2): optimized local copies of the game artwork in docs/art/landsraad, served from internal/web/static/lcc/art and the two cloth standards' feet (role standard-tip). Game artwork belongs to Funcom and is outside the repository licence (docs/art-notice.md); the two feet are design artwork supplied by the project owner. Both are described there. (The five 84 x 84 specialization badge crops of the approved design were removed on 2026-11-18, #963: the House card draws the five emblems of emblems/ instead, cut from the banner pictures, #976.) The tests compare this file with the embedded files byte for byte.
format: webp with alpha, encoded once from the reference PNG with the browser image encoder (quality 1.0 for the house symbols, 0.92 for the lane, banner and decree pictures); the reference PNG stays the source of truth

sizes.banner: 256 x 256: the reference banners are 256 x 256 and the folder README now says so too (it said 512 x 512 before M2); recorded in 05-m2-visual-foundation.md
sizes.emblem: 96 x 96 PNG with alpha (only the emblem of a path, cut from the 256 x 256 banner picture by scripts/lcc-emblems.mjs: the soft shadow and the two faded side copies are dropped, the emblem is trimmed, padded to a square and scaled down); the House card draws it at 28 px (24 px on a phone) in one tint. Game artwork derived from the extracted banner art: the same terms as the banners
sizes.decree: 128 x 128 (down from the 256 x 256 reference; shown at 96 px at most)
sizes.faction-mark: 256 x 256 (down from the 512 x 512 reference; shown at 150 px at most): the white faction crest on the header shields, the cloth standards and the claimed 13th seat
sizes.item: 64 x 64 WebP with alpha, one per reward item the Landsraad tiers give (the item id of the save is the file name), scaled down from the 256 x 256 item pictures of the Dune Docker console, which the editor reads as a read-only local source; shown at 48 px in the reward mouse-over and 28 px in its rows. Game artwork: the same terms as the other pictures (docs/art-notice.md). The 25 House swatches have no console picture and show no picture (the name only)
sizes.standard-tip: 320 x 111 and 319 x 111 PNG, the exact pixels of the approved plaque (no re-drawing, no re-encoding to a lossy format): the gold-edged V point of each cloth standard with its wheat ornament, rows 16 to 126 of the 150-row crop so that no baked-in text is in the picture; the files are design artwork supplied by the project owner, not game artwork
sizes.faction-medal: the reference size (100 x 100 Atreides, 104 x 104 Harkonnen): the round medallion of a claimed seat

houseAliasNote: The save and the editor spell the House Mikkarol; the reference picture and public trackers spell it Mikarrol. The runtime file is mikkarol.webp. Both spellings resolve through this explicit table; a file name is never built from a House name.
decreeArtNote: Matched by hand against the editor decree table (internal/ops/decree-names.json). basis "name": the picture is named like the decree. basis "subject": the picture shows what the decree is about. A decree that is not listed (the plain SpecialVendorActive row, an id the editor has never seen) gets decrees/fallback.svg, never a guessed picture.
decreeNotRuntimeNote: Reference pictures that no decree id of the editor table is matched to; they stay in docs/art/landsraad/decrees and are not embedded.
decreeMissingNote: docs/art/landsraad/README.md lists vendor-special, but the file does not exist; the plain SpecialVendorActive decree uses the neutral picture.

factionArt.note: The two faction crests, kept apart from the 25 House symbols and the five path icons (never mixed in one lookup). The white crest (factions/atreides.webp, factions/harkonnen.webp) is used on the two header shields, on the two cloth standards and on the 13th seat when a faction holds it. The round medallion (factions/atreides-medallion.webp, factions/harkonnen-medallion.webp) is used for every claimed seat of the track. Matched to the approved V20 plaque; see 05-m2-visual-foundation.md.
